keys.swarm.aura_phantom_blades_desc: Blades fly out and come back like boomerangs, cutting on the way out and the way back.
keys.swarm.aura_phantom_blades_ten: Death Blossom: a blossom of 12 blades all round.
keys.swarm.aura_smoke_veil_desc: A puff of smoke and you vanish: the horde runs to where you were.
keys.swarm.aura_smoke_veil_ten: Nightwalker: you stay unseen while moving.
